name: print-social-smart-techno-gaming-posts-navy-teal-gradient-controller
title: 'Smart Techno' gaming pack in navy with teal-green gradient game controller illustrations and headphone character
whatItIs: Five navy-and-black square posts with a teal-to-green gradient game controller line illustration, a flat character wearing headphones playing a controller, circular progress-ring accents, dashed lines, and headlines ('Smart Techno', 'Great Offer').
whatItMeans: Cool and energetic; the gradient controller motif and headphone character make a generic tech offer feel specifically gamer-focused.
techniques: Render a product icon (controller) in a bold gradient outline.
Repeat a headphone-wearing character as the campaign's face.
Add dashed lines and rings as light sci-fi texture.

vocabulary.definition: An icon drawn as a stroke filled with a colour fade.
A circular arc used as decorative texture.
